meta.source: Light theme measured from one uploaded page screenshot (assets/9e33a8d6f54c702c4dc749efe7cb3e1a.jpg, 736×1104): colours are pixel modes per region, rounded; sizes assume the screenshot is a 50% render of a 1440px desktop page. Dark theme derived on request, not measured.

tokens.name: navy-900
tokens.usage: Deepest navy. Utility bar, footer and the dark CTA band. Text on it is on-dark. Dark theme: a step below the ground so bars still read.

tokens.name: navy-700
tokens.usage: Brand navy. Primary buttons, the accent word in the hero heading, outline icons and the active nav link. on-dark text on it: 12.9:1 light, 4.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: navy-600
tokens.usage: Action navy. Subscribe button and the 'For sale' badge; hover/pressed state for navy-700 buttons (6.1:1 with on-dark in dark).

tokens.name: navy-300
tokens.usage: Translucent control chips over photos (the favourite heart on listing cards). Never for text.

tokens.name: navy-100
tokens.usage: Soft navy tint. Newsletter band background, icon circles in feature rows, selected-row highlight.

tokens.name: teal-600
tokens.usage: Brand accent — the logo's Lagoon Teal. Status badges ('For rent', 'New'), positive trend figures, the roofline bar in icons, link hover, focus rings. on-teal text on it: 5.0:1 light; in dark it lifts to Shallows with navy text (10:1).

tokens.name: teal-300
tokens.usage: Shallows. Highlights on navy surfaces only: the accent word in a hero on navy-900, chart accents, the teal inside reversed logos. Never for text on white (1.7:1).

tokens.name: teal-100
tokens.usage: Teal tint. Background of teal badges and success/positive callouts; icon circles when the feature is a calculator result.

tokens.name: on-teal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on teal-600.

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Headings, prices and card titles on surfaces.

tokens.name: ink-700
tokens.usage: Body text and nav links on surfaces (10.2:1 light).

tokens.name: ink-500
tokens.usage: Secondary text: addresses, feature descriptions, bed/bath meta, input placeholders (4.7:1 light, 6.9:1 dark — do not go lighter).

tokens.name: line-300
tokens.usage: Outline-button and control borders (3.3:1 on surface-0 in both themes).

tokens.name: line-100
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers, input borders, card edges.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Inactive pill tabs, chips and the secondary-button hover.

tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page background, cards, the search panel and the home-value chip.

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Text and icons on navy-900 / navy-700 / navy-600 in every theme.

tokens.name: on-dark-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on navy-900 (footer links). 7.9:1 on navy-900.

tokens.name: logo-navy
tokens.usage: The ink inside the logo files and app icons (Harbour Navy). Reference only — the files carry it; UI surfaces and buttons use navy-900 / navy-700.

families.sans: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
